adapter.workflow: MiniMax M3 receives one deterministic no-tools prepared Map packet over OpenRouter Chat Completions; the harness may supply one bounded NEED continuation or one focused patch repair, then owns apply and every declared gate
adapter.thinking: bounded by the adapter and excluded from response content

do_not_use_when: the ticket needs open-ended repository discovery
the packet has unresolved design alternatives
the required behavior cannot fit the TicketSpec's allowed paths
Engine work until an independently frozen Engine qualification passes
routing.promotion_evidence: two independently frozen Map tickets passed all harness-owned gates; the Engine controlled rollout failed its protocol contract and is disabled pending an Engine qualification

availability.rate_limit_policy: shared durable OpenRouter cooldown: 60 seconds, then 180 seconds, then 300 seconds capped
